title: Market Research Analyst
summary: A market research analyst runs surveys, focus groups and desk research to answer business questions about customers and markets. They usually work in a research agency or a company's insights team, designing studies, managing fieldwork, analysing data in tools like SPSS and Excel, and writing the report.
dailyDuties: Draft and revise questionnaires with the client
Brief field teams and check quotas and data quality
Write tabulation specs and check data tables
Analyse survey data in SPSS and Excel
Prepare discussion guides and observe focus groups
Write topline reports and debrief decks
Gather secondary data for market sizing

skills.expectation: Design questionnaires for brand, usage and concept studies
Brief field teams and monitor quotas, quality and back-checks during fieldwork
Clean and analyse survey data in SPSS
Write tabulation specs and check cross-tabs and banner tables
Run significance tests such as t-tests, chi-square and ANOVA
Write discussion guides and moderate or observe focus groups and depth interviews
Write topline reports and insight decks that answer the client's question
Gather and summarise secondary data and estimate market sizes
Clean data and build charts and tables in Excel
Present findings to clients and brand teams
Turn study results into consumer insights for brand teams
Build segments and personas from research
Turn results into clear charts and dashboards
Profile competitors as part of a study

certifications.why: Excel is used daily for data cleaning and charts in research reports.
